bullets.title: AVGO: Worst-ever earnings reaction (-15%) as Q3 AI guide misses; $300B AI rev thesis intact long-term
bullets.body: Broadcom fell ~15% post-earnings — its worst single-day earnings reaction in company history — after Q3 AI revenue guidance of ~$16B missed consensus near $17.2B and no FY27 outlook bump was provided. Stock was up ~40% YTD heading into the print. Despite the miss, JPM analyst Harlan Sur is calling for $300B in AI revenue by 2028, and Macquarie downgraded to Neutral from Outperform. Bloomberg Intelligence noted Google, Meta, and Anthropic wins did not meet elevated expectations.

bullets.title: CIEN: -14% despite beat-and-raise; AI networking capex cycle validated but bar was too high
bullets.body: Ciena beat Q2 revenue estimates and raised FY2026 guidance with the low end above prior consensus, but shares fell 13–16% — stock was up +165% YTD into the print. Analyst commentary describes the quarter as "materially positive" for AI-driven optical networking demand and a positive read-through for AI capex infrastructure, with a CFO NDR already scheduled for July 7.

bullets.title: RBRK: F1Q ARR beat $18M, FY27 guide raised $24M; PT $70 under review at KeyBanc
bullets.body: Rubrik subscription ARR of $1,565M beat consensus by $18M (33% YoY growth); revenue of $387M beat by $21M (39% YoY). EBIT margin of +6.4% beat consensus by 12 points and FCF of $74M beat by $27M. FY27 ARR guide raised to $1,854–1,862M, revenue guide raised $41M; FCF guide raised $28M. Stock trading at $77 vs KeyBanc PT of $70 (under review).

bullets.title: NVDA: Vera Rubin launches Q3 2026; $124B supply commitments secured; Nemotron 3 Ultra and Spectrum-X Photonics in production
bullets.body: At BofA Tech Conference, NVDA guided Vera Rubin platform to Q3 2026 with full production underway; $124B in supply commitments secured; hyperscaler and AI cloud each ~50% of revenue with hyperscaler growing faster. Separately, NVDA invested $2B each into Coherent and Lumentum for Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics (production since May 31), countering CPO cannibalization fears. Nemotron 3 Ultra launched with 5x faster inference and 30% lower cost for agentic tasks.

bullets.title: AAPL: Citi Buy, $315 PT; WWDC is AI catch-up play, near-term demand hardware-driven
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on AAPL at $315 (33x CY27 EPS); WWDC will focus on Siri overhaul and Apple Intelligence enhancements but Apple is "playing catch-up" rather than breaking new ground. iPhone demand near-term driven by hardware design and share gains, not AI; IDC revised global iPhone demand to -5% (from -8%) and China to -3% (from -9%). Separately, AAPL's revamped Siri will rely on Google's NVIDIA chip infrastructure at September launch. App Store ecosystem hit $1.4 trillion.

bullets.title: PLTR/NOW: UBS upgrades PLTR to Buy (70% grower, 50x FY27 FCF); NOW downgraded to Neutral
bullets.body: UBS software digest upgrades Palantir to Buy as a 70% revenue grower trading at 50x 2027 FCF — calling it a differentiated AI platform. ServiceNow downgraded to Neutral as UBS reassesses AI adoption impacts on the franchise. SNOW also upgraded to Buy, seen as early in a multi-year data investment cycle.

bullets.title: Jefferies 2H26 best ideas: CRDO, SNOW, AMZN, UBER, APP
bullets.body: Jefferies names its top 2H 2026 tech picks: CRDO (Blayne Curtis), SNOW and AMZN (Brent Thill), UBER (John Colantuoni), and APP (James Heaney). Jefferies is also hosting expert calls on ORCL, ADBE, and AI policy, plus NDRs for MSFT, COHR, and others.

bullets.title: DOCU: Q1 beat on revenue ($830M vs $825M est) and EPS ($1.09 vs $0.99); FY guidance raised
bullets.body: DocuSign beat Q1 on revenue, EPS (by $0.10), FCF ($289M vs $237M est), and gross margin (81.5%). IAM now 12.6% of ARR vs 10.8% prior quarter. FY27 revenue guidance raised to $3.490–3.502B; operating margin guidance raised to 30.5–31.0%. Revenue has beaten consensus in 20 of the last 20 quarters.

bullets.title: T and VZ down 3-4% after Supreme Court backs FCC in wireless fine case
bullets.body: The Supreme Court ruled in favor of the FCC's enforcement fine authority against T-Mobile and Verizon. T fell 3.3% and VZ fell 3.8% on the ruling, which affirms FCC's broad enforcement powers. The broader S&P 1500 Communications Index was +2.1%, led by GOOGL.

bullets.title: META: LightShed disputes reports of ad delay on non-IDFA iOS traffic; stock up 3.1%
bullets.body: LightShed contradicts recent reports that Meta is delaying its ad push into non-IDFA iOS traffic. META shares extended to session highs, up 3.1%. Separately, Coatue's Laffont noted Meta and Google are already monetizing AI with ~25% of ads incorporating AI, potentially reaching 100%.

bullets.title: BILL: JPMorgan cuts PT to $50 from $60 on RIF disruption; maintains OW, raises margin estimates
bullets.body: JPMorgan reduces BILL PT to $50 (from $60) citing near-term revenue disruption risk from reduction in force and management changes, but raises FY27 adj. op. margin forecast to 22.1% (from 17.9%) on improved cost structure. FY27 core revenue growth lowered to 13.8% YoY from 17.9% prior. Maintains Overweight.

bullets.title: PINS: $4B AWS cloud services deal signed; AWS collaboration expands
bullets.body: Pinterest signed a $4B Amazon Web Services cloud services deal per Raymond James. PINS also expanded its AWS collaboration per the SA Tech sector summary. Pinterest serves 600M+ users and is positioned as an AI-powered discovery platform.

bullets.title: DKNG: UBS raises PT to $49, Buy; PM ramp targeted by year-end with double-digit share
bullets.body: UBS raises DraftKings PT to $49 (from prior) on Q1 beat and promising Prediction Markets (PM) ramp. DKNG has 3-4% PM share in non-OSB states with limited marketing; targets double-digit share by year-end. New PM app features rolling out June. UBS 2026 EBITDA estimate $828M (+33% YoY), 2028E EBITDA $1.68B at 17x EV/EBITDA.

bullets.title: AMT terminates DISH Strategic Collocation agreement; no FY2026 financial impact
bullets.body: American Tower delivered a termination notice to DISH Wireless effective June 2, 2026, ending the 2021 Strategic Collocation agreement. 100% of DISH revenue has been reflected as churn since January 1, 2026; AMT says the termination will not impact its FY2026 financial results. AMT continues litigation against DISH over obligations under the agreement.

bullets.title: TSLA: TD Cowen reiterates Buy ($490 PT) on Model Y L US entry potential; 60k–135k demand upside
bullets.body: TD Cowen reiterates Buy on Tesla with $490 PT, modeling 30% volume uplift from potential Model Y L (3-row SUV) US launch adding 60k–135k in annual demand. Separately, a Tesla FSD user anecdote highlights deepening dependency on FSD after 28k miles of use over 18 months.

bullets.title: VRT: BofA hosted VRT CEO/CFO/CTO dinner at Datacloud Congress; June 8 Zoom on datacenter supply chain
bullets.body: BofA met 20+ datacenter supply chain companies at Datacloud Congress in France, including a dinner with Vertiv's CEO/CFO/CTO. Also met JCI, CARR, NVT, ETN, Delta Electronics, ABB, and Schneider Electric. Hosting a June 8 Zoom replay on demand trends, electrical/thermal architecture, HVAC, and behind-the-meter power.

bullets.title: CSCO: firewall portfolio refresh and Splunk ratable revenue normalizing by Q2 2027
bullets.body: At BofA Tech Conference, Cisco highlighted strong growth in refreshed hybrid mesh firewall products; Splunk transition to ratable revenue expected to normalize by fiscal Q2 2027. AI and infrastructure buildout driving robust security demand, with federal mandates expected to accelerate near-term activity.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Google/IBM AI partnership; Google announces Texas data center; AAPL Siri uses Google NVDA chips
bullets.body: IBM established a dedicated Google Cloud Practice with thousands of certified consultants for enterprise AI scaling. Google announced new data center investments in Gray and Roberts counties, Texas. Apple's revamped Siri will rely on Google's NVIDIA chip infrastructure at its September launch.

bullets.title: LULU: Q1 EPS beat but Q2 and FY guidance below consensus; stock -10.6% AH
bullets.body: Lululemon beat Q1 EPS but guided Q2 and FY below consensus citing consumer headwinds; gross margins in-line but below year-ago levels. Stock fell 10.6% in after-hours trading per SA Consumer sector summary.

bullets.title: MU/SNDK/AMD: Congressman Gottheimer discloses purchases; sits on House AI subcommittee
bullets.body: Rep. Josh Gottheimer filed disclosures of stock purchases in SanDisk (SNDK), Micron (MU), and AMD. Gottheimer sits on the House Subcommittee on AI, giving the purchases a thematic read-through to AI infrastructure demand.
